Name: Tophel
ModernLocation: Unknown; in the wilderness east of the Jordan
Description: Tophel was a landmark named with Paran, Laban, Hazeroth, and Dizahab in the opening of Deuteronomy, as the places opposite the Jordan where Moses spoke to Israel.
BiblicalSignificance: Tophel is one of the wilderness landmarks of Deuteronomy's setting: a name on the edge of the promised land before Moses' farewell words.
